items.heading: Most Students Shopping
items.text: Most students shopping for an education loan for study abroad India start by comparing interest rates across a few homepages. That comparison is close to useless on its own, because the rate a lender advertises usually applies to a specific product tier, a secured loan, a top university, or a high-income co-applicant, that may not match your actual situation. The real first question is structural: are you offering collateral or not, and does your target university even qualify for the loan type you want.

items.heading: A Secured Education Loan Requires
items.text: A secured education loan requires your family to pledge an asset, usually residential or commercial property, but sometimes fixed deposits, government bonds, or other approved securities, as collateral against the loan. An unsecured loan requires no such pledge, and the lender instead underwrites the loan against your admitted course, the co-applicant's income, and the university's placement track record.

items.heading: Three Broad Lender Categories Fund
items.text: Three broad lender categories fund study abroad education in India, and each one solves a different problem for a different kind of applicant.
